title: V5: dedupe seal_lease_renewed logs per tip_h
brief: Owner: cluster suppress noise fixed; seal_lease_renewed sometimes doubled (same tip_h, ~1-2s apart). Cause: step_lease Renew every seal tick while log uses tip_h%10==0 without dedupe — cluster gate stalls height but lease renews each tick.

design.root_cause: crates/pwmd/src/lifecycle.rs run_lease_gate: LeaseEvent::Renew logged when h%10==0 on every seal loop tick; multiple ticks at same tip_h (pending cluster) emit duplicate renew lines
design.fix: Log seal_lease_renewed at most once per tip_h for milestone heights (track last_renew_log_tip on App or seal-loop local state); optional debug! for repeat renews same tip_h
explicit_non_goals: No change to lease TTL or renewal frequency

acceptance_criteria: At steady CY soak on tip_h=25910/25920 etc.: at most one INFO seal_lease_renewed per tip_h milestone.
seal_lease_acquired / takeover / loss / reject behavior unchanged.
Unit test or lifecycle test: two Renew events same tip_h -> one info log.
notes: Orchestrator RCA from owner terminal; review skipped.
